notes.title: Version 9.7
notes.content:
- fixed issue with players who are released from team not being cleared properly from sub matrix in some cases
- fixed issue with incorrect scouting notes being generated for post play
- fixed player suggestions not taking properly from text message option on player card
- fixed issue where player could show same school twice in top ten
- added HTML page for top 25 polls
- added items to commissioner database export

notes.title: Version 9.6
notes.content:
- fix for offer scholarship button on recruit card not working properly at some phases of offseason
- added ability to watch selection show in MP league as commissioner
- fixed database editing issue for conference names

notes.title: Version 9.5 update
notes.content:
- fix for HTML output of team logos on league leaders page
- fix for team info graphic changes not displaying properly in some instances
- fix for coaches changing jobs in universe mode
- fix to judge 4 and 5 star recruiting goals by the WSSN ranking instead of by actual ratings
- fix in multiplayer mode for suggestions to be sent in their own file and with a limit of one at a time
- fix to prevent you from being able to offer scholarships to recruits who will not be eligible for your school based on SAT score after SAT scores are revealed
- added change to reveal all SAT scores after testing date in game

notes.title: Version 9.4
notes.content:
- Fix for school info page showing wrong conference for conference championships
- Fix for pipeline not resetting when coach retires 
- Improved save function
- MP fix for depth chart resetting in some cases
- MP fix for locked lineup resetting
- MP fix for game preview not showing for non-commissioner teams

notes.title: Version 9.3
notes.content:
- Fix for top ten showing as blank on recruit cards if they are a low ranked recruit in a region you purchased a premium report in
- Expanded willingness for lower ranked recruits to look out of state and take visits out of state
- Fix for updating multiplayer leagues and automatically loading them after download
- Fix to make insights page load better
- Allowed drop down MP users box to scroll for commissioner

notes.title: Version 9.2
notes.content:
- MP load will take you right to the league after league files have been downloaded
- Fix for crash editing conferences in database editor
- Fix for team who uses no offensive sets at all and 100% transition offense
- Fixed HTML box scores not being generated
- Logo fixes on certain screens with custom logos
- Fixed disparity in injury reporting in game preview
- Fixed relegation error at end of season in promotion/relegation leagues
- Corrected eFG calculation on leaders page
- Instructions for coach offensive pace and press usage will translate to 2D gameplay now when updated in office
- Added (LIVE) to your scouting notes if the notes you received on the player were from scouting in person as opposed to scouting tape

notes.title: Version 9.1 Update
notes.content:
- fixed issue where HOT/WARM/COOL tags would display differently on recruit card vs recruit screen
- fixed issue where new teams were not appearing in standings of independent conference in promotion/relegation league
- changed HTML output to fix conference standings pages and also link team pages to conference standings
- fixed rare issue where if the ball was knocked out of bounds after a broken press and missed layup attempt the defense would not reset properly on next play
